items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-10-14
items.q: he went on a boat with Sun White and Em... Sun White was washing dishes in the kitchen, and playing with the band at night.

ctx.x: Well, a friend of mine, we went to school together, but the name was Luis Andre. Well, my brother was playing, stopped playing the violin. He was still playing the violin, but he was taking trumpet lessons, and I was taking cladid lessons, and Luis wanted to play saxophone. In other words, he was on the first one I ever played a piece on. The first piece I ever played on a saxophone, believe it or not, it was a two-land swing. It was a very first piece on, pre- and St. Philip, next to Peter Claiborne's Church. It…
What year was it about now?
